brief: The AI course business that scales. Course architecture, pricing tiers, community add-on, AI-powered support.

slots.headline: Build an AI Course Business That Scales
slots.body: Discover the blueprint for a high‑margin AI education empire. From modular architecture to tiered pricing, we’ll show you how to grow fast and stay profitable.

slots.title: Design Modular Course Architecture
slots.body: Break content into bite‑size modules that can be combined into pathways. This flexibility boosts learner retention and lets you upsell advanced tracks.

slots.title: Create Tiered Pricing Plans
slots.body: Offer a free starter, a premium core, and an elite mastermind tier. Each adds value—more content, live labs, and exclusive AI tools—to capture every budget.

slots.title: Add Community as a Paid Add‑On
slots.body: A private AI forum fuels peer learning and retention. Charge a monthly community fee to unlock networking, mentorship, and real‑time AI challenges.

slots.title: Integrate AI‑Powered Support
slots.body: Deploy chatbots to answer FAQs, grade assignments, and suggest next modules. AI support reduces overhead while delivering instant, personalized help.

slots.title: Automate Marketing & Funnels
slots.body: Use AI to segment leads, personalize emails, and predict churn. Automated funnels keep the pipeline full without constant manual effort.

slots.title: Measure, Iterate, Scale
slots.body: Track enrollment, completion, and revenue per module. Iterate quickly based on data, then replicate winning pathways across new AI topics.

slots.headline: Start Building Your Scalable AI Course Today
slots.body: Apply the framework, launch your first module, and watch revenue grow. Need help? Reach out for a free strategy call.
